rules.name: bi-tool-usage-01
rules.sql: SELECT function_id, name, category, target_table, is_active, left(definition::text, 400) AS definition_start FROM opera.opera_bi_tool_report_functions ORDER BY function_id
SELECT function_id, name, category, target_table, is_active, left(definition::text, 400) AS definition_start FROM opera.opera_bi_tool_report_functions ORDER BY function_id
SELECT r.name, r.view_type, r.status, r.source_type, r.report_function_id, r.created_by, r.created_at FROM opera.opera_bi_tool_reports r ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.name, r.view_type, r.status, r.source_type, r.report_function_id, r.created_by, r.created_at FROM opera.opera_bi_tool_reports r ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT 'function' AS kind, f.function_id AS id, f.name, f.target_table, f.is_active FROM opera.opera_bi_tool_report_functions f WHERE f.function_id ~* :names OR f.target_table ~* :names OR f.definition::text ~* :names UNION ALL SELECT 'report', r.id::text, r.name, NULL, NULL FROM opera.opera_bi_tool_reports r WHERE r.config::text ~* :names OR r.logical_columns::text ~* :names ORDER BY 1, 3
